ActivateFlowLog.title: Activate flow log
ActivateFlowLog.summary: Enables log delivery for a flow log.

AttachExpressConnectRouterChildInstance.title: AttachExpressConnectRouterChildInstance
AttachExpressConnectRouterChildInstance.summary: Attaches a child instance (VBR) to an Express Connect Router (ECR).

CheckAddRegionToExpressConnectRouter.title: CheckAddRegionToExpressConnectRouter
CheckAddRegionToExpressConnectRouter.summary: Checks the Cloud Data Transfer (CDT) service, which is required to add a region to an Express Connect Router (ECR).

CreateExpressConnectRouterAssociation.title: Associate a resource with an ECR
CreateExpressConnectRouterAssociation.summary: Associates a virtual private cloud (VPC) or a transit router (TR) with an Express Connect Router (ECR).

CreateFlowLog.title: CreateFlowLog
CreateFlowLog.summary: Creating a flow log enables log delivery by default.

DeactivateFlowLog.title: DeactivateFlowLog
DeactivateFlowLog.summary: Deactivates log delivery for a flow log.

DeleteExpressConnectRouterAssociation.title: DeleteExpressConnectRouterAssociation
DeleteExpressConnectRouterAssociation.summary: Disassociates an Express Connect Router (ECR) from a virtual private cloud (VPC) or a transit router.

DescribeDisabledExpressConnectRouterRout.title: DescribeDisabledExpressConnectRouterRouteEntries
DescribeDisabledExpressConnectRouterRout.summary: Queries the disabled route entries for an Express Connect Router (ECR).

DescribeExpressConnectRouter.title: DescribeExpressConnectRouter
DescribeExpressConnectRouter.summary: Queries a list of Express Connect Router (ECR) instances.

DescribeExpressConnectRouterAllowedPrefi.title: DescribeExpressConnectRouterAllowedPrefixHistory
DescribeExpressConnectRouterAllowedPrefi.summary: Queries the prefix route history for an Express Connect Router (ECR).

DescribeExpressConnectRouterAssociation.title: Query resources associated with an ECR
DescribeExpressConnectRouterAssociation.summary: Queries the virtual private clouds (VPCs) and transit routers (TRs) associated with an Express Connect Router (ECR).

DescribeExpressConnectRouterChildInstanc.title: Query child instances associated with an ECR
DescribeExpressConnectRouterChildInstanc.summary: Queries the virtual border routers (VBRs) loaded on an Express Connect Router (ECR).

DescribeExpressConnectRouterInterRegionT.title: DescribeExpressConnectRouterInterRegionTransitMode
DescribeExpressConnectRouterInterRegionT.summary: Queries the inter-region transit mode of an Express Connect Router (ECR).

DescribeExpressConnectRouterRegion.title: DescribeExpressConnectRouterRegion
DescribeExpressConnectRouterRegion.summary: Queries the regions that contain Express Connect Router (ECR) resources.

DescribeExpressConnectRouterRouteEntries.title: DescribeExpressConnectRouterRouteEntries
DescribeExpressConnectRouterRouteEntries.summary: Describes the route entries of an Express Connect Router (ECR).

DescribeInstanceGrantedToExpressConnectR.title: DescribeInstanceGrantedToExpressConnectRouter
DescribeInstanceGrantedToExpressConnectR.summary: Queries the network instances that are granted to an Express Connect Router (ECR).

DetachExpressConnectRouterChildInstance.title: DetachExpressConnectRouterChildInstance
DetachExpressConnectRouterChildInstance.summary: Detaches a virtual border router (VBR) from an Express Connect Router (ECR).

DisableExpressConnectRouterRouteEntries.title: DisableExpressConnectRouterRouteEntries
DisableExpressConnectRouterRouteEntries.summary: Disables route entries for an Express Connect Router (ECR).

EnableExpressConnectRouterRouteEntries.title: EnableExpressConnectRouterRouteEntries
EnableExpressConnectRouterRouteEntries.summary: Enables route entries for an Express Connect Router (ECR).

ForceDeleteExpressConnectRouter.title: ForceDeleteExpressConnectRouter
ForceDeleteExpressConnectRouter.summary: Force deletes an Express Connect Router (ECR) and detaches its associated virtual private clouds (VPCs), Transit Routers (TRs), and virtual border routers (VBRs).

GrantInstanceToExpressConnectRouter.title: GrantInstanceToExpressConnectRouter
GrantInstanceToExpressConnectRouter.summary: Grants a virtual private cloud (VPC) or a virtual border router (VBR) from another account to an Express Connect Router (ECR).

ListExpressConnectRouterSupportedRegion.title: ListExpressConnectRouterSupportedRegion
ListExpressConnectRouterSupportedRegion.summary: Queries the regions that support Express Connect Router (ECR).

ListTagResources.title: Query ECR tags
ListTagResources.summary: Queries the list of tags bound to an Express Connect Router (ECR).

ModifyExpressConnectRouter.title: ModifyExpressConnectRouter
ModifyExpressConnectRouter.summary: Modifies the properties of an Express Connect Router (ECR), such as its name.

ModifyExpressConnectRouterAssociation.title: ModifyExpressConnectRouterAssociation
ModifyExpressConnectRouterAssociation.summary: Modifies the parameters of an instance associated with an Express Connect Router (ECR).

ModifyExpressConnectRouterAssociationAll.title: ModifyExpressConnectRouterAssociationAllowedPrefix
ModifyExpressConnectRouterAssociationAll.summary: Modifies the prefixes for a virtual private cloud (VPC) or a transit router that is attached to an Express Connect Router (ECR).

ModifyExpressConnectRouterChildInstance.title: ModifyExpressConnectRouterChildInstance
ModifyExpressConnectRouterChildInstance.summary: Modifies the properties of a virtual border router (VBR) associated with an Express Connect Router (ECR).

ModifyExpressConnectRouterInterRegionTra.title: ModifyExpressConnectRouterInterRegionTransitMode
ModifyExpressConnectRouterInterRegionTra.summary: Modifies the inter-region forwarding mode of an Express Connect Router (ECR).

ModifyFlowLogAttribute.title: ModifyFlowLogAttribute
ModifyFlowLogAttribute.summary: Modifies the name, description, sample rate, and sampling period of a flow log.

MoveResourceGroup.title: MoveResourceGroup
MoveResourceGroup.summary: Moves an Express Connect Router (ECR) to a specified resource group.

RevokeInstanceFromExpressConnectRouter.title: RevokeInstanceFromExpressConnectRouter
RevokeInstanceFromExpressConnectRouter.summary: Revokes the authorization for a virtual private cloud (VPC) or a virtual border router (VBR) to access an Express Connect Router (ECR) owned by another account.

SynchronizeExpressConnectRouterInterRegi.title: SynchronizeExpressConnectRouterInterRegionBandwidth
SynchronizeExpressConnectRouterInterRegi.summary: Synchronizes the inter-region bandwidth limits for an Express Connect Router (ECR).

TagResources.title: Bind tags to an express connect router
TagResources.summary: Binds tags to an Express Connect Router (ECR). Each call to this operation binds tags to a single ECR instance, but you can bind multiple tags at a time.

UntagResources.title: Unbind tags from an Express Connect Router
UntagResources.summary: Unbinds tags from an Express Connect Router (ECR).
